ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَمَّا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّجْزُ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَى ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ ۖ لَئِن كَشَفْتَ عَنَّا ٱلرِّجْزَ لَنُؤْمِنَنَّ لَكَ وَلَنُرْسِلَنَّ مَعَكَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/ش/ف   k–sh–f to uncover, to remove, to bare, to reveal, to disclose
; to have a receding hairline; to weaken in battle.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 20 times in the Qur’an:
كَشَفَ kashafa 13 times; يُكْشَف yukshaf 1 time; كَشْف kashf 1 time; كَاشِف kāshif 2 times; كَاشِفوا kāshifū 1 time; كَاشِفَةٌ kāshifatun 1 time and كَاشِفَاتٌ kāshifātun 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
كَاشِف kāshif [act. part.; pl. كَاشِفُون kāshifūn; fem. كَاشِفَةٌ kāshifatun; pl. كَشِفَات kāshifāt] one who removes, takes away, bares

(39:38) إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ if God desires harm for me, are they able to remove His harm?

entries.label: كَشَفَ
entries.definitionHtml:
كَشَفَ kashafa i [v. trans.]

1 to bare, to uncover

(27:44) حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا she took it to be a deep pool of water, and bared her legs

2 to relieve from

(23:75) وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ even if We had showed them mercy and removed the affliction that is upon them

3 to take off, to remove

(50:22) فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ We have removed from you your covering, so your sight today is sharp,

entries.label: كَشْف
entries.definitionHtml:
كَشْف kashf [v. n.] (the act of) removing, taking away

(17:56) فَلاَ يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَحْوِيلا they have no power of removing harm from you nor of averting [it].

entries.label: يُكْشَف
entries.definitionHtml:
يُكْشَف yukshaf [imperf. pass. v.] to be bared, to be exposed *

(68:42) يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ on the Day when matters become dire, the Day of Judgement [lit. the Day when legs are bared],
